integrity: The universality of the formula rests on an explicit Fourier-symbol and periodic Green-function proof; finite numerical checks are provided as reproducibility evidence, not as proof. Source access limitations and known continuum results are identified in the scientific review.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to unweighted periodic n-cycle second-difference penalties with n>=5. It gives a two-term asymptotic for the eventual finite-grid positivity threshold, not all finite-n positivity intervals or weighted/open-boundary analogues. The continuous limiting threshold is established prior art, not a claimed discovery. Historical priority for the parity corrections awaits independent assessment.
title: Parity-split positivity thresholds for periodic biharmonic smoothing
